title: SplitterLayout
description: A horizontal or vertical layout with pointer- and keyboard-resizable panes.

usage.summary: Give users control over the space shared by adjacent content panes.
useWhen: Resize a preview beside an editor or above a related panel.
Set a minimum size on panes that need to remain usable while resizing.

avoidWhen.when: Navigate among responsive list, detail and sub-detail pages.
